title: Sender identities
blurb: Settings → Compose previews each exact From address and its Morrow-only display name. Verified Gmail send-as names are the default; local overrides survive refresh. Clear a name for address-only sending or reset to the default. Most people only need a display name. Domain CC/BCC, aliases, and the fallback CC domain stay under Advanced, collapsed until one of those rules is saved. Compose From lists authorized addresses for every connected mailbox; choosing another mailbox sends and saves drafts there. Switching mailboxes preserves body formatting and links, and keeps a signature you edited. Only untouched automatic signatures, including multiline HTML signatures, follow the new mailbox. Drafts and scheduled mail retain the selected name and address, including punctuation and Unicode in names. Bot mail.send uses these defaults on the granted account only. Provider sending permissions still apply; Gmail settings and OAuth scopes stay unchanged. Providers or recipient contacts may affect the delivered display. The Compose mailbox selector is in Basic, above sender names, Preferred From and Signatures; alias and domain rules remain in Advanced. Question-mark help explains the mailbox, Preferred From and fallback CC domain. Refresh From addresses sits beside Sender identities and keeps local overrides.
